summary: All three exact-hash council lanes rejected compact v1.7. The reproduced handoff and forward-retirement scope is valid, but the spec has an invalid exact SHA, contradictory Check Run authority, a privileged candidate-code trust boundary, ambiguous tuple/duplicate rules, and incomplete crash/permission/test contracts.
validation: Remote main is d3565f534b2f64585c3e15e35d8d645449f4f09d; the spec exact-main literal omitted its final d.
Planner, security, and QA independently returned NO-GO.
Administrator evidence v2 independently matched 4024 bytes and SHA 55dbee3772ce06d0af59df8cb21d6862d4d167470065e2580ff9adb3d28efb58.
Live canonical URL evidence is check 97655710504; Automatic Release 32798160604 failed after Release Verify 32798188729 succeeded.
No Publish Release, release, package, draft, tag movement, or asset write occurred.
Schema/checker structure passed 19 MUSTs, 10 acceptance criteria, 10 tests, and 19 trace rows before semantic rejection.
No repository, GitHub, release, package, or cluster mutation occurred during council review.
blockers: Separate unprivileged candidate verification from protected-main privileged signing/dispatch over immutable digest-bound outputs.
Define canonical tuple bytes/digest/encoding and exact host/repository/check-ID URL binding with fail-closed duplicate precedence.
Define crash-safe publisher dispatch identity/receipt and manual handling for ambiguous read-after-write.
Specify an exact per-workflow/job permission matrix, including narrowly scoped checks:write only for the trusted serialized creator.
Scope v0.6.13 retirement to mutable publication-authority paths and prove all mutation-capable entry points cannot publish it.
Make filter=all pagination, proof ordering, ancestry, bounded polling, fake clock, and negative fixtures executable.
Represent issue #98 as PR #99's external blocker, then rebase/check/merge #99 before rebasing/checking #94 after verified v0.6.14.
next_action: Revise a current-main v1.8 specification with the council's exact trust-boundary, canonicalization, state-machine, permissions, retirement, fixture, and sequencing contracts; rerun exact-hash council.
